steps.content: While the monster is temporarily hiding, the two of you keep running until you both exhaust your strength and must take a break in a cave.
Hestia sits collapsed on the ground, both her legs and her hands holding the torch still shaking, but she doesn't stop grumbling.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: ...You idiot... Idiot!!

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I've told you the monster can't be killed. Why must you push your luck? That red light of yours is useless. You're even shorter than me. Did you really think you could take on that thing?!

steps.speaker: Option
steps.content: ...Thanks for saving me.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: There won't be a next time! I'll let you die if it happens again! Sob...
The girl gasps for air, her hands and legs shaking violently, tears streaming down uncontrollably.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I, I'm out of strength. The monster will catch up soon. We're really going to die this time, aren't we? Oh no, what should we do...
It's hard to believe she just ran up to you and beat up that monster she feared so much and actually drove it away.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well...
This whole time, you've been constantly reminding yourself to stay rational and see Hestia as a trap set by the Illusory Moon instead of a companion. You've been keeping your guard up against her.
But now, it seems you might have misread the situation. To defeat that monster, you need her help.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: What?
At the mention of an <color=#fb9259>idea</color>, Hestia scoots closer as if grasping at straws.
But considering it comes from that <color=#fb9259>little punk</color>, she seems somewhat hesitant.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've thought of a way to deal with that monster.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Are you insane? Going to get yourself killed again?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Just hear me out...
Despite her skepticism, this still gives her a glimmer of hope, so she moves closer...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Although my attack didn't work earlier, you managed to hurt it. Why do you think that is?

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Don't know, just luck I guess...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Because you were being brave just now.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Brave? Me?
The girl looks incredulous, then asks.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Let's just say... I was being brave. But what does that have to do with hurting the monster?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It makes all the difference.
It concerns the root of this darkness, where we need to go, and...
You lean forward slightly, moving closer to the girl.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And how we... defeat that monster!
